claims: Storrs, Connecticut, is a census-designated place in the town of Mansfield.
Storrs is the home of the University of Connecticut (UConn) main campus.
Storrs has a population of nearly 16,000.
Storrs is situated in Tolland County, eastern Connecticut.
Storrs is roughly halfway between New York City and Boston.
Betsy Paterson Square is in Downtown Storrs.
The Ballard Institute and Museum of Puppetry is on the UConn campus.
Shelter Falls Park is a nearby nature spot.
Whetten Woods is a nearby nature spot.
Storrs has major watch parties for the NCAA championship-winning men's and women's teams.
Storrs is named after Charles and Augustus Storrs.
Charles and Augustus Storrs provided the land and funds to establish the university in the 1880s.
